title: Epic Chicken Tacos
reject_reason: Salsa-verde/honey/taco-seasoning shredded chicken with cheese, romaine and pico is the same Tex-Mex chicken-taco identity as live slow-cooker-chicken-tacos-rice-bowls; the taco-shell vehicle does not make a distinct plate in an already-crowded region, and an in-flight sriracha chicken taco is also pending.
